statement: Link another Revit project into the host by reference with positioning options and a live path.
superiority: Handle links in the background so a large link never blocks the canvas.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Linked model appears at the chosen origin and its element count is readable but unmodified.

statement: Link an IFC file into the project as a converted reference using a cached Revit-format copy.
superiority: Keep an IFC link live-linked to the source file without a conversion step.

statement: Link a DWG, DXF, DGN or SAT/SKP file as a reference with units, positioning and layer visibility.

statement: Link a topography source such as a point or surface file to form a surface.
